text_block_list.text:
The day of the All Comers. Arriving at 
Nakayama Racecourse, someone was waiting 
at the entrance—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It was her friend, Twin Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"I'm super energetic today, so I'm totally 
gonna win!" While receiving that 
full-spirited "deklaration of war" from 
Twin Turbo—
